subject: pkg/dxf, pkg/lightning: improve local engine cleanup diagnostics (#66958)
summary: Moves IMPORT INTO local-sort cleanup into an earlier defer so local engines get best-effort cleaned even when failures occur before sharedVars is stored (improves retry behavior). Changes local backend CleanupAllLocalEngines to log annotated per-engine cleanup/finishWrite failures internally (with task-style start/end logs) instead of returning an error, and adds targeted tests for both behaviors.
